headline: Cardinals LT Paris Johnson Jr. Out For Season
summary: The Cardinals’ latest rebuilding season will include 13 missed games from their left tackle. Mike LaFleur said Monday that Paris Johnson Jr. suffered a biceps tear and will miss the rest of the season. headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater Suffers High Ankle Sprain
summary: Four games into his comeback season, Rashawn Slater will be shut down once again. Tests confirmed Monday the Pro Bowl Chargers left tackle suffered a high ankle sprain, according to NFL.com’s Ian Rapoport. headline: Vikings LG Jackson likely out for season, LT Darrisaw has concussion
summary: Vikings left guard Donovan Jackson is headed for what is likely season-ending surgery to repair a meniscus tear, and left tackle Christian Darrisaw is in the concussion protocol.

headline: Ravens unsure if Lamar Jackson (ankle) will play vs. Falcons
summary: The Ravens are uncertain whether quarterback Lamar Jackson will play Sunday night against the Falcons.

headline: Packers LB Edgerrin Cooper has season-ending torn Achilles
summary: Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper suffered a season-ending Achilles tear during Sunday's 17-14 victory over the Buccaneers.

headline: Ben Johnson: Tyson Bagent will start at QB for Bears vs. Packers
summary: Tyson Bagent will be the Bears' starting quarterback for Sunday's game at the Packers, coach Ben Johnson announced Monday.
